updates.title: Current release
updates.content:
Galactic Idle is live with the full core loop: build up your homeworld, research a full tech tree across six branches, build a fleet, and take the fight to the galaxy.

- **Unified Starmap** — conquest and exploration now share one interwoven star map. Send your task force hopping across planets and sectors, stage from owned territory for cheaper travel, and watch the frontier respawn faster the more you control.
- **Command Doctrines** — spend Command Points earned from conquest on a 3-branch doctrine tree as your empire grows.
- **Diplomacy & covert ops** — trade with factions, sign non-aggression pacts and alliances, or run espionage and covert missions against rivals.
- **Offline progress** — come back to resources earned while you were away.
- Available in English, German, Spanish, French, Indonesian, Polish, Portuguese, Russian, and Chinese.
